level2.godSpeak: Congratulations citizens! I wrote you a short book about this level. Please read the book in your inventory called S1L2
level2.page1: Congratulations! You just upgraded your town to level 2. This is big! There's a few things happening each time you level up. This time you unlocked a game called "roulette". More on that on the fourth page. In addition to unlocking new features, you also receive chunk points.
level2.page2:
----Chunk points----
Each time you level up, you receive a chunk point. With the chunk point, you can purchase a nearby chunk. This allows you to extend your plot. To unlock your second chunk. Stand next to the borders of the chunk you want to unlock, and look into it. Then type the...
level2.page3:
following command:
/buychunk now

You can see information about your chunk points and the price of purchasing a chunk by typing the command:
/buychunk info

Keep in mind that you have to pay tax for each chunk you own.
level2.page4:
------Roulette------
Roulette is a game that runs once an hour. You will be notified in the chat when the game is running. The game functions like a lottery, and allows you to pay for a chance of winning precious items.
level2.page5:
----Renting tools----
Another feature you unlocked, was the ability to rent tools. By typing /rent info, you can see what tools you can rent. The tools will become better as your town levels up. For now it's quite good iron tools. They even have enchantments. Just make sure not to...
level2.page6:
steal the tools. The tools should be kept in your inventory at all time. If you loose it, you will have to pay... A lot!

When done renting the item, hold it in your main hand, and type:
/rent end

level3.godSpeak: Congratzzz! A new level is a new book, read the book in your inventory please
level3.page1: Sweet! You've made it to level 3. That means you're rewarded your second chunk point! Just remember that you pay tax for every chunk you own. You don't have to use the chunk point. However, if you decide to use it. Build something clever on it. Something that can make you even more money.
level3.page2:
--------Pay--------
You now have the ability to pay another player. This can be achieved by executing the command
/pay <username> <amount>

 Keep in mind that you pay tax for this as well!
level3.page3:
-----Treasury-----
Your town now has an important role: the 'Treasury Chancellor'. This is a powerful position that helps manage the town's economy and financial decisions. While their full abilities are not unlocked yet, this role will be crucial as your town levels up!
level3.page4: Other than that, there's not much more to level 3. No more features or anything. Sounds quite boring, doesn't it? Well, the next one will be big. I promise!

level4.godSpeak: Congratulations! Please read the book i wrote about this level. I got big news!
level4.page1: Oh wow! Your town is rocking level 4. This is amazing! I promised you something big for this town upgrade. I wasn't lying. You unlocked a feature called "wilderness". This feature allows you to get out of your town for a short period of time. During that time, you are not restricted by the...
level4.page2: size of your own chunk, and can explore the wilderness.
level4.page3:
---- Wilderness ----
Wilderness allows you to be teleported outside your chunk to the free open world for a short period of time. It is not free however. To see the available commands, do /wilderness

level5.godSpeak: Fantastic work! Your town just hit level 5. There's a book in your inventory with all the juicy details!
level5.page1: Level 5! Now we're talking. With this upgrade, your town is getting stronger, and you're gaining more control over your world. You've earned another chunk point, meaning you can expand your territory again. But that’s not all! This level introduces a brand-new ability: capturing.
level5.page2:
-----Capturing-----
You can now capture animals and villagers and bring them into your chunk. No more waiting for them to wander in randomly! To capture a creature, stand next to it and type '/capture'.

level6.godSpeak: Incredible progress! A new level means a new book. Check your inventory for all the details!
level6.page1: Level 6 is here, and with it comes two powerful new features that will change how your town operates. First, you now have access to the '/chunkguard' command, which allows crops and plants to grow even when no one is online.
level6.page2:
----Chunk Guard----
With '/chunkguard', your land stays alive even when you log out. Crops will keep growing and nature won’t wait for you to return. Just keep in mind that it comes at a price — 2000 per chunk per hour. Use it wisely!
level6.page3:
-----Donations-----
Your town’s treasury chancellor now has access to a command: '/treasury buy donations'. This command will halve the amount of resources needed for your next level-up. If your treasury is looking strong, this might be a worthy investment!

level7.godSpeak: You just reached level 7! Check your inventory for an exciting update on what’s new.
level7.page1: Your town is getting more connected! With level 7, you’ve unlocked a brand-new ability that makes visiting other players easier than ever before.
level7.page2:
------Visiting------
You can now visit other players' chunks using the command: '/visit <playername>' This will teleport you directly to their chunk — if they accept your request.
level7.page3:
------Consent------
Of course, no one wants uninvited guests! The player you want to visit must approve your request before you can teleport to their chunk. This makes trading, collaborating, and checking out other chunks much easier!

level8.godSpeak: Another level, another big step for your town! Check your inventory for details on what’s new.
level8.page1: Level 8 brings an opportunity: underground mining. If you’ve been struggling to find resources in your chunk, this new command will let you dig deeper — literally!
level8.page2:
------Mining------
With '/wilderness mining', you will be teleported to an underground mining zone where you can strip mine for resources. You’ll have 45 minutes before being teleported back to your chunk. Keep in mind that you must stay below height level 16 at all time.
level8.page3:
--Chunk Discounts--
The Treasury Chancellor now has access to the command '/treasury buy chunkdiscount'. This command permanently reduces the cost of buying chunks for all players. The town must use tax money wisely, but a discount like this can help expand faster!

level9.godSpeak: Level 9 has arrived, and with it, new opportunities! Check your inventory for all the details.
level9.page1: Your town just unlocked access to the Nether! This dangerous yet resource-rich dimension is now within your reach, giving you access to materials you couldn’t find before.
level9.page2:
------Nether------
Using the command: '/wilderness nether', you will be teleported out of your chunk and into the Nether. Be prepared—the Nether is unforgiving, but the rewards are worth the risk!
level9.page3:
-----Refunds-----
The Treasury Chancellor now has the ability to give money back to the people! With the command '/treasury withdraw', every player will receive 4000 from the town’s tax money. However, there’s a catch! There’s also an extra fee of 10,000

level1.godSpeak: A new season has begun! Season 2 is here, bringing fresh challenges and exciting new opportunities. Check your inventory for all the details!
level1.page1: Welcome to Season 2! You’ve worked hard to build your town, and don’t worry — you’re not starting over. Your chunk, your progress, and everything you’ve built remains intact. But things are about to get even more interesting!
level1.page2:
---New Wilderness---
With the start of the new season, the '/wilderness world' command now takes you to a brand new spawn location. That means fresh lands, new terrain, and untouched resources waiting to be claimed.
level1.page3:
----Better Tools----
The rental system has been upgraded! From now on, when you rent tools, you’ll be getting diamond tools instead of iron. This will make gathering materials easier and more efficient.
level1.page4:
-------Events-------
Season 2 introduces a new concept: events. These events fall into two categories: excursions and arena fights.
level1.page5:
----Excursions----
You’ll be taken to unique locations full of loot—abandoned towns, hidden caves, and mysterious ruins.
level1.page6:
----Arena Fights----
 A battle against waves of monsters! These fights will get tougher as the season progresses, so prepare yourself.
level1.page7:
---Price Changes---
Times are changing, and so are the prices. Things are a bit more expensive now, so managing your resources wisely will be more important than ever.
level1.page8:
---Mystery Chests---
The Treasury Chancellor has a powerful new ability! With the command: '/treasury buy mysterychest', A mystery chest will spawn in the trade chunk. These chests come in four tiers: BASIC, GOLD, PLATINUM, and DIAMOND.
level1.page9: Season 2 is here, and it’s only going to get more intense from here. With new events, tougher challenges, and better rewards, the adventure is just beginning!

level2.godSpeak: The economy is evolving! You now have access to a brand-new way to grow your wealth. Check your inventory for details!
level2.page1: Congratulations on reaching Level 2! This upgrade brings a major financial opportunity - the stock market. Now, you can invest your money and watch it grow (or disappear)!
level2.page2:
-----Stocks-----
With the command: '/stocks', you can buy and sell stocks. Stock prices fluctuate over time — some will rise, some will fall, and some might even go bankrupt. Choose wisely! And by the way, unlike your cash holdings, stocks are exempt from wealth tax.
level2.page3: The stock market is unpredictable, but those who play it right can become incredibly wealthy. Just remember: with great risk comes great reward!

level3.godSpeak: Speed and efficiency are key! Your town just unlocked a powerful way to work faster. Check your inventory for details!
level3.page1: Welcome to Level 3! This upgrade brings a new ability to your town’s leadership. The Treasury Chancellor now has access to a powerful buff that can boost everyone's productivity.
level3.page2:
---Haste Boost---
With the command: '/treasury buy haste', every player in the town will receive the Haste effect for 3 minutes, allowing you to mine and gather resources much faster!

level4.godSpeak: New gear is now available for rent! Check your inventory for details!
level4.page1: You've reached Level 4, and with it comes a new rental option! The /rent command has been expanded to include Turtle Shells, allowing you to breathe longer underwater.

level5.godSpeak: Take to the skies! A new rental option has arrived. Check your inventory for details!
level5.page1: You've reached Level 5. You can now rent an Elytra! With the command: '/rent elytra', you can temporarily soar through the skies and explore the world from above.

level6.godSpeak: Entrepreneurs, it’s your time to shine! Your town just unlocked the ability to start businesses. Check your inventory for details!
level6.page1: Welcome to Level 6! You now have access to the '/business command, allowing you to start and manage your own business. Whether you want to run a bank, an insurance company, or an export business, the choice is yours!
level6.page2:
-----Starting a Business-----
To start a business, use the command: '/business start'. Each business type has a startup fee. Choose wisely, because you can only operate one business at a time. However, you can shut down your business and start a new one whenever you like.
level6.page3:
-----Business Bank Account-----
Each business has its own bank account, where you can deposit and withdraw money. Depositing is tax-free, but withdrawing money comes with tax. Profits made inside the business stay tax-free until withdrawn.
level6.page4:
-----Export Business-----
The cheapest business to start. Here, you'll receive export missions, where they must collect specific items, put them in a chest, and ship them. Once shipped, you receive a payment!
level6.page5:
-----Insurance Business-----
Here you can create insurance plans and set their monthly price. If priced correctly, customers will subscribe, generating passive income. However, accidents can happen, forcing payouts to cover claims!
level6.page6:
-----Bank Business-----
This is the most expensive business to start. You'll receive loan applications and can choose to approve or reject them. If approved, you'll pay out the loan and earn interest as customers repay. But beware — some loans might default!
level6.page7: Becoming a business owner is risky, but it can also be incredibly profitable if managed well. Choose your path wisely and build your fortune!

level7.godSpeak: Gravity? That’s old news. Your town just unlocked the ability to fly! Check your inventory for details!
level7.page1: Welcome to Level 7! With this upgrade, you now have access to the '/fly' command, allowing you to take to the skies just like in creative mode!

level8.godSpeak: Sometimes, progress is its own reward. Check your inventory for details!
level8.page1: You've reached Level 8! No new features this time, but that doesn't mean your town isn't growing stronger.

level9.godSpeak: Tired of the dark? Your town just unlocked the power to control time! Check your inventory for details!
level9.page1: You've reached Level 9, and with it comes a powerful new ability — the '/day' command. No more waiting for sunrise. Now, you can instantly turn night into day! It doesn't come for free though. The price? 14990...

level1.godSpeak: A new season begins! Something feels... different. Check your inventory for details!
level1.page1: Welcome to Season 3! You’ve kept your chunk, your progress, and your hard work. But there’s an energy in the air — a feeling that change is coming.

level2.godSpeak: Progress marches forward, but what are we marching toward? Check your inventory for details!
level2.page1: You’ve reached Level 2! Everything seems normal, yet… something is shifting. The world feels a little different, don’t you think?

level3.godSpeak: Have you noticed it? The feeling that something big is on the horizon? Check your inventory for details!
level3.page1: Level 3 is here. And by now, you must have sensed it too. The world feels less... confined. As if the walls around us are growing weaker.

level4.godSpeak: Almost there. Almost time. Can you feel it? Check your inventory for details!
level4.page1: Level 4! The whispers of change are no longer whispers. Something is about to happen. Something that will alter everything you know.

level5.godSpeak: The time has come. Everything is about to change. Check your inventory for details!
level5.page1: You did it. Level 5. The moment you’ve been waiting for is here. The world has been holding you back, but not anymore.
level5.page2: The borders will fall! The walls that once contained you will be gone. The world is about to open. No more limits. No more restrictions. Go forth and claim it!
